senses.gloss: f. = h. שׁוּק II, desire, pleasure, satisfaction.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 8:11">Cant. R. to VIII, 11</cite> <he>לית ש׳ מן גביכון</he> no satisfaction comes from you (the angels), i.e. your compliance with the Law would afford no satisfaction to Me, because you have no temptations and trials to contend with.
